title: How Chemistry Amplifies a Small Enantiomeric Imbalance
summary: Starting from an almost equal mixture of molecular mirror images, a reaction can make one form overwhelmingly predominant. Kagan’s nonlinear effects and Soai’s asymmetric autocatalysis, recognized by the 2026 chemistry Nobel, reveal how that small imbalance grows. The question leads to solid-state calculations of chiral charge-density waves and their interaction with polarized light.
